description: Budget Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. Where does your money go each month? Type your take-home pay and what you spend. See what is left, and how it fits the 50/30/20 rule. It takes your spending from your take-home pay. Then it compares the split to a rule of thumb like 50/30/20. It does not see your bank account. It only adds the numbers you type. People ask for it as "budget calculator", "monthly budget calculator" or "how to make a budget".
